text.p: Syratech Corp said Wednesday its company's shareholders approved the previously announced acquisition of the company by Thomas H. Lee Equity Fund, a Boston private investment company.

A company spokeperson said shareholders approved the deal Monday. Shareholders will receive $32 per share or may elect to exchange up to 34.75 percent of their shares held for the surviving company, subject to proration, as noted in the company's proxy.
The acquision was first announced on October 23, 1996 and is expected to close this week.
Syratech Corp designs, manufactures, markets and distributes tabletop, giftware and seasonal products.
